nodes.label: KYC Document Upload (/console/documents)
nodes.rationale: Onboarding creates the account; KYC activates it. Moves the identity/business document pack from email into the console.

nodes.label: connect-api interaction 586 — fetch required document list
nodes.rationale: Keyed by `id` (not interaction_type_id) in buildRoleTransactionList because every composite interaction reports interaction_type_id: 0.

nodes.label: connect-api interaction 587 — upload one document (multipart)
nodes.rationale: Every field travels URL-encoded inside a single `formdata` part; files are sibling parts file1..fileN — connect-api's own convention, not general multipart.

nodes.label: uploadInteraction (shared multipart transport)
nodes.rationale: Support-ticket attachments already use this transport, so KYC upload reuses one helper instead of a second multipart implementation.

nodes.label: KYC_NO_RECORDS — "No Records Found" is an empty state
nodes.rationale: Upstream returns a failed envelope for an account with nothing outstanding; matching the message renders a reassuring empty state instead of a red error. Message-matching is all upstream gives; prefer a response_type_id if one ever surfaces.

nodes.label: kycEnabled / useKycEnabled entitlement gate
nodes.rationale: Requires BOTH 586 and 587 — listing without uploading renders a page whose every button fails upstream. Returns null while unresolved so callers distinguish 'not entitled' from 'not yet loaded'. Two independent guards (rail item + page) because a nav item is not access control.

nodes.label: parseDocumentList (presentation overlay, drops is_required)
nodes.rationale: is_required is deliberately not carried across — an incomplete pack fails at review days later, so offering 'optional' is offering a slow way to fail.

nodes.label: KYC_DOC_CONFIG — per-doc_type local overrides
nodes.rationale: Upstream's list is shared across Eko products and says nothing about how a document should be captured. Local always wins (`??` merge); an unknown doc_type gets an empty config, never an error.

nodes.label: Watermark provenance stamp (opt-in per doc_type)
nodes.rationale: Only doc_type "24" (live photograph) asks: a stamp is evidence about a capture this console witnessed; on a scan of a pre-existing card it defaces the document and proves nothing. Images only; never combine with options.disableImageConfirm.

nodes.label: Sample documents (sampleUrl blanks in public/kyc-samples)
nodes.rationale: For documents whose wording is Eko's to dictate (board resolution, declarations). Files are committed so a revision is a reviewable diff; kyc-docs.test.ts pins the path shape and on-disk existence so a rename fails CI instead of 404-ing.

nodes.label: DOCUMENT_STATUS / statusOfDocument (1 pending, 2 success, 3 resubmit)
nodes.rationale: Unknown codes are treated as not-yet-uploaded, never a false 'done'. `uploadedNow` bridges the gap between an upload and a refetch that may not yet reflect it.

nodes.label: KYC file rules (KYC_TYPES, KYC_EXTENSIONS, KYC_MAX_FILE_BYTES, KYC_MAX_PAGES)
nodes.rationale: Explicit type list rather than image/* — the wildcard admits HEIC, WEBP and SVG (a script carrier). MIME AND extension must both pass because the browser supplies both and either alone is trivially wrong. KYC takes 10 MB where a ticket attachment takes 5; backend copy is authority.

nodes.label: KycUploadDialog
nodes.rationale: Plain shadcn Dialog, deliberately not a DialogHost entry, so camera/editor/viewer portals stack above it on their own. On failure it stays open with files attached — re-picking pages after a network blip is the worst recovery.

nodes.label: ignoreNestedDialogInteraction (Radix top-layer guard)
nodes.rationale: Radix defers its top-layer test to the click after pointerdown; the upper dialog unmounts during that click so the lower one reads as topmost and dismisses itself. Not reproducible under jsdom — checked by hand at /console/test.

nodes.label: `multiple` — per-slot attachments combined into one PDF
nodes.rationale: A phone rarely gets a whole Aadhaar card square in one frame. Per slot, not per document; a single attachment passes through unchanged so nothing becomes a PDF that did not need to be.

hyperedges.label: KYC document upload flow (entitlement → list → parse → dialog → upload)
